title: artemisia maritima var. gallica
intro: Artemisia maritima var. gallica, commonly known as Gallic Wormwood, is a variant of the Artemisia maritima plant species, a type of perennial herb native to the coastal regions of Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Gallic Wormwood include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Gallic Wormwood may also contribute to its potential as an anti-cancer agent and its ability to modulate the immune system.
